cellwork.before: A committed T1 with a lost reply was absent from the cell checkpoint. Revision 2 added T2 for the unchanged key and left a dropped T1 pending.
cellwork.after: The same board row is adopted for an unchanged freeze. A removed pending row is cancelled. A changed row is replaced with a distinct contract after its predecessor is closed. Running and ambiguous predecessor rows block supersession. A second lost reply converges through revision 3.

autoproject.before: The real Boulder completion call failed when the ledger was read-only. The persisted work remained active while the run and its own goal reported completion.
autoproject.after: The run requires a successful transport and a completed payload for its own Boulder work ID. A rejected or thrown acknowledgement leaves the run boulder-pending and its goal armed. The exact ledger work can be retried and acknowledges the same terminal result on replay.
autoproject.retryBound: The named mpd_boulder_complete retry completes the ledger work. The original autoproject run and its goal retain their recorded state.

independentVerification.exactRedToGreen: 1 pass, 2 failures before; 3 pass, 0 failures each on final source and rebuilt distribution
independentVerification.extendedRedToGreen: 1 pass, 7 failures before; 8 pass, 0 failures each on final source and rebuilt distribution

verificationBound: The regressions invoke registered tools in process with the real durable Team and Boulder stores, a real goal bridge, and a fixture host transport.
